version.description: Schema version. Must equal 1 for current parser.

exportedAt.description: Unix epoch millis when the export was created.

id.description: Provider item ID. Sanitized on import.

source.description: ContentSource enum name. Validated against known sources on import.

thumbnailUrl.description: HTTPS thumbnail URL. Required non-blank for WALLPAPER; may be blank for SOUND.

sourcePageUrl.description: HTTPS link to the original source page.

addedAt.description: Unix epoch millis when the user favorited this item.

sourceAvailability.description: AVAILABLE or SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE. Normalized to AVAILABLE on null/blank.

sourceAvailabilityReason.description: Human-readable reason when source is unavailable.

importValidation: id must be non-blank after trim
source must match a known ContentSource enum value
type must be WALLPAPER or SOUND
thumbnailUrl must be HTTPS (may be blank for SOUND type)
sourcePageUrl, if present, must be HTTPS
sourceAvailability is normalized to AVAILABLE if null or blank
Items exceeding maxImportItems are silently dropped

versionPolicy.bumpRule: Increment version when adding required fields or changing field semantics. Optional nullable fields may be added without a version bump.
versionPolicy.forwardCompat: Unknown fields are silently ignored by Moshi. Future versions with higher version numbers are rejected with user-visible copy.
versionPolicy.backwardCompat: Version 1 files remain importable. New optional fields default to null on older exports.
versionPolicy.unsupportedVersionCopy: This file was exported by a newer version of Aura. Please update the app to import it.

privacyExclusions: Export does not include provider API keys or user credentials
Export does not include download file paths or device storage locations
Export does not include community identity UIDs or Firebase auth state
sourcePageUrl may contain third-party provider URLs with query parameters

collectionName.description: Collection display name, capped at 80 chars on import.
